visualReview.method: In-memory original-size gray-composite sheets with red head and blue foot crosses; corrected sheets inspected again; four ambiguous staff/raised-foot poses magnified. Original PNG pixels and Unity metadata were not edited.
footCorrections: Natalia entire sheets: bottom boot regions; original body band sometimes ended 20-34px too high.
Mint and Tear damage-left: explicitly include raised rear boot.
visualReview.remainingUncertainty: No unresolved weapon-versus-head or coat-versus-sole identification. Antialiased contour thresholds can shift coordinates by about 1-2 source pixels; raised-foot midpoint is an artistic anchoring choice.

scaleSuggestions.referenceMeaning: Existing authored head-to-imported-foot-pivot; no claim that this is a fresh old-art sole measurement.
scaleSuggestions.method: Per-sheet median of four directional rest/recovery heights divided by old head-to-pivot local units; existing body scale remains unchanged.
